big_fat_buddy: The new machine gunner is Marek "Brick" Buddy, once a railway porter from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a railway porter was any use in a trench. Marek "Brick" Buddy said he would find out. Marek "Brick" Buddy walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
